description: Source code implementing configuration translation functions for CU-UP units, including config generation, QoS setup, and worker manager configuration.

methods.name: generate_cu_up_config
methods.description: Generates a CU-UP configuration object from a given unit config, setting various parameters including timers, metrics, and test modes.

methods.name: generate_cu_up_qos_config
methods.description: Creates a map of QoS configurations indexed by five_qi, either default or based on provided QoS configs, with validation for duplicates.

methods.name: fill_cu_up_worker_manager_config
methods.description: Populates a worker_manager_config object with settings derived from a CU-UP unit configuration, including executor queues, tracing, and pcap settings.
